content.text: I've reviewed the compensation, termination, and liability sections plus targeted searches for penalty/LD language.

input.quote: Upon any such termination, Contractor will be paid all fees and expenses that have been incurred or earned in connection with the performance of the Services through the effective date of such termination.
input.rationale: No liquidated damages, penalty, or minimum-fee-on-termination obligation is imposed on Clear Capital anywhere in the Agreement. Searches for "liquidated damages", "penalt", "interest", and "Company shall pay" return nothing relevant. Section 3 (Contractor's Compensation) provides only for time-and-materials fees, expenses and taxes, with no late-payment penalty. Section 6 termination is available to either party on fifteen days' notice, and both § 6(b) and § 7(c) limit Clear Capital's post-termination exposure to fees and expenses actually incurred or earned through the termination date — i.e. no early-termination fee or stipulated damages. Section 7(a) caps Clear Capital's liability at fees paid, and § 7(b) waives consequential damages both ways. This meets the preferred position (no Customer-payable liquidated damages or penalties), so no redline is required.
